notes.title: New Update Available
notes.content:
New update is available. Below is a detailed change log.
Restart the Steam client if you do not see update.

Thank you all for helping us recognize and fix these issues.

[h1]Fixed crashes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Auto save game crash issues resolved
[*]Crash on next day if start game was set to before 7am
[*]Crashes due to unlinked shaders fixed
[/list]

[h1]New features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Automatic GPU detection to detect very low GPU configuration
[*]Chicken breed and sell functionality added
[*]Enter vehicle by looking at it and triggering input action
[/list]

[h1]Other fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Removed rain in shop
[*]Optimized GPU memory consumption (~40 MB)
[*]Optimized CPU performance (~2ms per frame)
[*]Stay in shop after buy
[*]Exist shop with the same key as entering shop (when mouse not over menu)
[*]Increased door/barrier keep open range
[*]Gecko L pipe fixed
[*]Fixed some helper path issues
[*]Return to farm key has confirmation message box now
[*]Milk jug positions fixed
[*]Filtering out PhysX logging
[*]Added option to disable shadow smoothing (memory and rendering optimization) for detail level 2
[/list]
